fact: When the user approves an initial project save and no policy was configured, the defaults are .fact/models.tsv and modelGitTracking=false.
When the user selects a Git-tracked project table, saving the model configuration stages the table with the project settings.
Linked worktrees share the primary checkout’s local project model table. If an existing ignore rule does not cover it, the plugin adds the path to the shared Git info/exclude file.
A project table uses a path under .fact/; a personal table uses ~/.agents/taskbook-models.tsv with Git tracking disabled.
The settings reader translates the older single storage choice into a model-table path and Git tracking policy.
On a model-settings save, the plugin updates and stages .fact/taskbook.tsv as a two-column key/value table. A worktree based on the resulting commit inherits that policy.
